name: Breadboard rails
description: The four distribution rails of an upright solderless breadboard: logic ground and 3.3V on the left, motor ground and motor supply on the right.
notes: Used by layout: breadboard. The renderer draws these as the breadboard power strips instead of a device box. The renderer ties GND to MGND whenever MGND is used. +24V is the external motor supply (EXT_POWER role).
